string.value: Find the Mirror World Map in the Treatment Room
Mark told me you were coming to rescue Larelle. You'd better not harm a hair on his head! That little boy is a good boy. He didn't mean to hurt those people. We were trying to keep him safe.
Larelle said he was s-sorry? What a... brave little... champion! Oh no... here come the waterworks. Please... leave. I'm an explosive crier.
Corba really said that? That he'll slice the egg in half? Hm... Fine! I'd rather have half of the egg than lose it to Yaku. So tell Yaku to just give up!
What?! Slice the egg in half? That's so cruel! That'll destroy the egg!
I'll give the egg up. I don't know what kind of tricks Ito might pull, but it'd be better than slicing it in half. Please tell #bCorba#k not to do that... Please, I beg you!
We must point our swords forward and poke them at our enemies! We don't want to be trapped in our own town! We have to show them our power, and then they'll leave us alone.
No war! The dragon eggs will be threatened if there's a war. I'm happy with the way things are!
Only cowards run away! We must march forward and defeat all enemies! Just... don't put me on the front lines.
Hahahaha, war? Are you kidding me? Halflingers aren't built for war! We don't have fangs or claws or strong muscles. Plus we're tiny!
This way, that way... It doesn't really matter.
The shiniest thing in Ariant? It's obviously me! You're blinded just looking at me, aren't you?
The shiniest thing in Ariant is none other than... Sirin! Oh, my Sirin...
You're looking for the shiniest thing in Ariant? Then look no further. It's everywhere!

Yes, the sand. Nothing is shinier in a desert. #r#t4033907##k, which is mixed with gold, is blinding under the desert sun. You can get #r#t4033907##k by defeating #bDesert Giants#k at Outside North Entrance of Ariant.
Obviously what Schegerazade wants the most is my affection! A fairy's attention is what all humans want!
What Schegerazade wants? Hmm... She's already got royal food and pretty clothes... I'm not sure what else she would want. Maybe #bJiyur#k would know. Schegerazade is his sister!

string.name: conditionContent
string.value: Steal Tigun's riches from Tigun's House.

string.name: conditionContent
string.value: Place 50,000 mesos into the pot at the house with the blue and pink canopy.
What? Heena won't be friends with me? Well, I don't wanna be friends with HER. Utah says she's been spilling my secrets all around town, and that's why I picked someone ELSE to be my partner today.
So tell Heena that I don't need a friend who talks behind my back! Oh, and be sure to tell her Maya was MY friend first!

Camila said what? But I never told anyone her secrets! That Utah! He must be pulling another one of his pranks! Tell Camila I never betrayed her trust, and that's it's HER fault she believed Utah instead of her own best friend!
Heena denied it? But she's the only one who knew that I like Evan! Tell Heena I don't believe her stupid story!
Oh my gosh, EVERYONE knows Camila's in loooove with Evan! IT's so obvious! I was the one who stopped Utah from telling Evan! Tell Camila that!
Really? Heena did that for me? But Utah said... Well, Utah was probably lying. Gee, you should probably tell Heena I'm really sorry...
A friend for Anne? I want to play with her too, but I can only take so much. I get sick a lot, so you'll need to find someone else.
You want me to be friends with Anne? Well, she and I don't have much in common. I'm a history buff and she's not.

I heard from No Gong. I take care of the pharmacy, but I forgot to lock the doors last night. It was probably around 9 when I got out. I don't remember anything, except that I ran into #rMr. Gong#k on my way.
Was I at the Pharmacy yesterday? Yeah, I needed some medicine to fight off this cold. But Mr. Do was already gone, so I gave up and went to bed early.
Did I see anyone? Um, let's see... #rDalsuk#k was running off somewhere... I asked her what's up, but she ignored me.

L-last night? I'm trying to watch what I eat, but I got so hungry that I... I ate all the #bKuzu Vine Roots#k at the pharmacy! I wanted to chew on something... Meat? No, I haven't even looked at meat in awhile...
Did I see someone at the Pharmacy? Hm... I did see #rLan Ming#k on my way out. He jumped when he saw me. He must've wanted Kuzu Vine Roots, like me.
What did I do at the Pharmacy last night? Somebody saw me, huh? It's true. I'm actually... Dating #rLilishu#k. We tried to be discreet, but now the secret is out...
That's right... I was with #bLan Ming#k last night. We thought it'd be isolated, but we were wrong. I saw #rMu Tan#k heading inside as we were leaving.
Did Smartie give up? I knew he'd never be able to find me here!\r\n
I'm glad the game's over. I want to go home and eat! I'm starving!\r\n
Smartie's the worst at hide-and-seek. I was just munching on candy the whole time.

string.name: conditionContent
string.value: Post the petition on the Edelstein Message Board.
So people are have keeled over after eating Juliet's lunch? Argh, I knew something like this would happen. Juliet has no business cooking... She can't cook. Period. Well, unless you count poison.

Digestive pills? That won't do anything against Juliet's monstrous cooking. Give #r#t4009061##k and #r#t4009062##k to whoever ate her food. That should bring them back around. They'll still need rehab, though. Maybe therapy.
Yeah, Korin hasn't hugged me very much lately. Maybe it's cause I got skinnier? I need to stuff more cotton into my belly!
Korin is a very nice child. She still laughs at my hasty magic. But for some reason she stopped laughing lately. Maybe something's bothering her?
I've been feeling a little hopeless since Korin hasn't come to see me. She would sometimes come to wind my spring, but now nobody's doing it. Could you wind my spring since you're here?
Oh, Korin? I haven't seen her lately. She was huge a fan of toys, so she'd often come to the factory. Maybe she's feeling ill? Maybe her friend #rNemi#k knows something.
Why is Korin feeling so down lately? Probably because of her family. They're all really busy working at the toy factory, so Korin is often home alone.
I don't know how you know the #rAmnesiac Temple Keeper#k, but I'd stay away from him, if I were you.
Memories can't really be lost. They can be put in a corner or covered up, though...
The Amnesiac Temple Keeper? Oh, you must be talking about Kao. You say he's looking for his lost memories? A fool's errand, that. Not...that I would know anything about it.
#rKao#k has been around for a long time. Only the elder keepers know why he lost his memory.
Did he lose his memories again? I see. This has been a cycle... I knew he'd seek his memories again at some point.
It's stupid to let the past control you...
Did #rKao#k erase his memories again? I do wonder what he experienced that was so ruinous...
#rKao'#k been erasing and returning his memories for awhile now. Makes sense...he gets rid of them, forgets whatever it was that was so terrible, tries to get them back, and so on...
